meta.description: Estimates biological replicate or donor counts for genomics experiments using FDR-aware ssizeRNA calculations, DESeq2/edgeR pilot dispersions, PROPER simulations, donor pseudobulk, and multiplicity-adjusted proteomics calculations.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All calculations used synthetic fixtures or explicit formula parameters; no fabricated clinical findings, citations, or study results were asserted.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill plans study sample sizes, distinguishes human-donor planning from protocol authorization, and routes clinical-trial endpoints elsewhere.

methodological_ground.detail: Executed outputs counted biological units rather than technical replicates or cells, used pilot-derived vectors where required, and applied panel-wide multiplicity adjustment for proteomics.

code_usability.detail: All copied shipped R paths parsed and completed with asserted output and exit code 0 in the supported isolated R 4.4.3/Bioconductor 3.20 route.

functional_suitability.note: Covers scalar, pilot-vector, fixed-budget, PROPER, donor-pseudobulk, and multiplicity-adjusted proteomics planning; powsimR is explicitly routed to a justified fallback.

reliability.note: Seeds, assertions, source guards, and actionable unreachable-target errors are present; the lengthy worked example emits routine simulation warnings without a runtime expectation.

performance_context.note: The complex workflows are moved to parameterized scripts, though the complete simulation example is relatively expensive for an illustrative first run.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, unit-of-analysis warnings, parameter explanations, and explicit error messages make the workflow clear from a cold start.

human_usability.note: The description matches natural planning requests and the skill clearly distinguishes sample-size planning from clinical-trial design.

security.note: No credentials, destructive operations, or raw code evaluation are present; file inputs rely on R and package diagnostics rather than a separate path preflight.

maintainability.note: PROPER and pseudobulk routes are modular scripts with bounded arguments; the same small ssizeRNA guard is intentionally duplicated for standalone execution.

agent_specific.note: Trigger wording is precise, layered guidance is concise, seeded examples are repeatable, and clinical and infeasible-target escape hatches are explicit.
